senses.gloss: Daśāśva, a king of Māhishmatī. § 720b (Sudarśanop.): XIII, 2, 89 (son of Ikshvāku), 90 (father of Madirāśva).
Daśagrīva^1, a Daitya. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): II, 9, 367 (in the palace of Varuṇa).
Daśajyotis, son of Subhrāj. § 3 (Anukram.): I, 1, 44, 45 (father of 10,000 sons).
Daśamālika, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 374 (among the peoples of the north).
Daśāpārśva, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 363 (only B.; C. has Daśārṇāḥ).

Daśaratha, king of Ayodhyā and father of Rāma. § 383b (Paraśurāma): III, 99, 8656 (Daśarathasya putro Rāmaḥ), 8660.--§ 391 (Ṛshyaśṛṅga): III, 110, 10008 (Lomapādaḥ sakhā Dºsya).--§ 525 (Rāmopākhyānap.): III, 273, 15877 (son of Aja, husband of Kausalyā, Kaikeyī and Sumitrā, and father of four sons: Rāma on Kausalyā, Bharata on Kaikeyī, Lakshmaṇa and Śatrughna on Sumitrā).--§ 527 (do.): III, 277, 15947, 15949, 15957, 15974, 15976 (Kaikeyī prevailed upon D. to let Bharata be anointed and to banish Rāma; then D. died).--§ 530 (Viśvāvasumokshaṇa): III, 279, 16045 (sakhā Dºsya…Jāṭāyuḥ), 16064 (sakhā Dºsya, i.e. Jaṭāyu).--§ 543 (Rāmābhisheka): III, 291, 16549, (16556) (D. appeared to Rāma and attested the innocence of Sītā, and commanded him to return to Ayodhyā and rule there).--§ 548e (Vishṇu): III, 315, 17467 (Vishṇunā vasatā cāpi gṛhe Dºsya vai--i.e. incarnate as Rāma Dāśarathi--Daśagrīvo hataḥ).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 74, 3616.--§ 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7677.
Dāśarathi^2, dual (ºī) = Rāma and Lakshmaṇa: III, 15946 (Rāma-Lakshmaṇau).

Daśārha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 320 (Saubhavadhop.): III, 19, 769 (sarvaº).--§ 402 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 120, †10263 (ºsenā, will assist the Pāṇḍavas in the battle), †10287 (ºvīrāḥ).--§ 451 (Mārkaṇḍeyas.): III, 183, †12588 (ºyodhāḥ, will assist Yudhishṭhira), †12591 (ºyodhaiḥ). Cf. Dāśārha, pl.

Dāśārha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people (= Daśārha, pl.). § 243 (Vidurāgamanap.): I, 205, 7513 (the followers of Kṛshṇa). --§ 271 (Lokapālasabhākh.): II, 12, 511 (ºnagarīṃ, i.e. Dvārakā).--§ 553 (Vaivāhikap.): IV, 72, 2350 (many D. came from the Ānartta country to Upaplavya along with Kṛshṇa and Abhimanyu).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 7, 171 (ºpravaraiḥ, follow Kṛshṇa).--§ 569 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 140, 4749.--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 110, 4232 (na hi Dºā raṇe rakshanti jīvitaṃ, so B.; C. has Dºo…rakshati), 4233 (bhīrūṇām asatāṃ mārgo naisha Dºsevitaḥ; C. reads Dāśārha (i.e. Sātyaki) sevitaḥ in two words).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 65, 3299 (sarva-Dāº-mukhyaḥ, i.e. Kṛshṇa).--§ 773c (Durvāsas): XIII, 160, 7431 (kecit). Cf. Daśārha, pl.
Dāśārha, adj. (“belonging to Dāśārha, i.e. Kṛshṇa”).-§ 263 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 3, 84 (ºī Sudharmā, i.e. Kṛshṇa's sabhā).
Dāśārhaputraja = Dhṛshṭaketu: XI, 229 (Cedirājaṃ, Nil.: atra putryām api putraśabdaḥ (the mother of Dhṛshṭaketu must then have been a Daśārha princess)).
Dāśārhī^1 (“daughter of the Dacārha king”) = Vijayā, wife of Bhumanyu: I, 3786 (Vº).
Dāśārhī^2 (“do.”) = Sudevā, wife of Vikuṇṭhana: I, 3789 (Sº).
Dāśārhī^3 (“do.”) = Śubhāṅgī, wife of Kuru: I, 3792 (Śº).

Daśārṇa, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 177 (Pāṇḍudigvijaya): I, 113, 4449 (vanquished by Pāṇḍu on his digvijaya).--§ 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 29, 1063 (in the east, vanquished by Bhīmasena on his digvijaya).--§ 285 (Nakula): II, 32, 1189 (in the west, vanquished by Nakula on his digvijaya).-§ 350 (Nalopākhyānap.): III, 69, 2708 (tvam tu jātā mayā dṛshṭā (C. ºtvā) Dºeshu pitur gṛhe, says Sunaṇḍā's mother, daughter of Sudāman, the king of the Daśārṇas, to Damayantī, the daughter of her sister).--§ 549 (Pāṇḍavaprav.): IV, 1, 12; 5, 144 (uttareṇa Dºāṃs te Pañcālān dakshiṇena ca).--§ 573 (Ambopākhyānap.): V, 189, 7420 (ruled by Hiraṇyavarman).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 348 (in Bhāratavarsha), 350 (do.), 363 (do., only C.; B. has Daśāpārśvaº).--§ 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 51, 2103 (in the army of Duryodhana, followed Droṇa).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 26, 1162 (rājā Dºānāṃ, fought Bhagadatta).--§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 22, 864 (attacked the Pāñcālas).--§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 83, 2470 (at the time of Yudhishṭhira's horse-sacrifice the D. were ruled by Citrāṅgada, who was vanquished by Arjuna).
Daśārṇa (“king of the Daśārṇas”) = Hiraṇyavarman: V, 7493 (pārthive), 7519.
Dāśārṇa^2 (do.) = the king of the Daśārṇas at the time of the great battle. § 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 95, 4276 (fought Bhagadatta).
Daśārṇādhipati^2 (do.) = Hiraṇyavarman: V, 7417 (ºeḥ sutāṃ, married to Śikhaṇḍin), 7425, 7459, 7483, 7498, 7500, 7512.

Daśārṇādhipati^3 (do.), the king of the Daśārṇas at the time of the great battle. § 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 95, 4255 (among the Pāṇḍava warriors) (), 4271 (attacked Bhagadatta).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 26, 1164 (attacked Bhagadatta).

Dāśārṇaka, adj. (“belonging to the Daśārṇas”). § 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 29, 1063 (ºo rājā Sudharmā).--§ 573 (Ambopākh.): V, 189, 7418 (ºsya nṛpateḥ, i.e. Hiraṇyavarman, Ś. has Daº), 7419 (Hiraṇyavarmeti nṛpo yo 'sau Dºḥ smṛtaḥ), 7428 (ºo rājā, i.e. Hiraṇyavarman); 190, 7454 (do.); 191, †7462 (ºe nṛpatau = do.); 192, 7490 (ºo rājā = do.).
Daśārṇanṛpa (“king of the Daśārṇas”) = Hiraṇyavarman: V, 7503.
Dāśārṇeśa (do.), the king of the Daśārṇas at the time of the great battle. § 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 50, 2080 (in the army of Yudhishṭhira).
Dāśārṇika, adj. (“belonging to the Daśārṇas”). § 573 (Ambopākh.): V, 189, 7424 (dhātryaḥ). Cf. Dāśārṇaka.
Daśāvara, an Asura. § 268 (Varuṇasabhāv.): III, 9, 367 (among the Daityas and Dānavas in the palace of Varuṇa).
Daśeraka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 589 (Droṇābhishek.): VII, 11, 397 (had formerly been vanquished by Kṛshṇa).--§ 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 20, 798 (in the army of Duryodhana). Cf. next.

Dāśeraka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): 50, 2080 (ºgaṇaiḥ, in the army of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 580 (do.): VI, 56, 2409 (ºgaṇaiḥ, in the army of Duryodhana; C. has Dāsº).--§ 587 (do.): VI, 117, 5483 (ºgaṇāh, attacked Arjuna; C. has Dāsº). Cf. prec.
Dāśeyī (“daughter of the fisherman”) = Satyavatī: I, 4015; V, 5966 (C. Dāsº).
Daśīvidarbha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 372 (in the south; B. has Ṛshīkā Vidabhāh).

Dāsamīya, pl. (ºāḥ), a people(?). § 607 (Karṇap.): VIII, 44, 2056 (vrātyānāṃ Dāsamīyānāṃ Bāhīkānām ayajvanāṃ | na devāḥ pratigṛhṇanti, etc. PCR. translates “begotten by Śūdras on the girls of other castes” (agreeable to Nīl., who, however, also gives another explanation: Dasamadeśodbhāvānāṃ)), 2069 (vrātyānāṃ Dºānām annaṃ devā na bhuñjate, PCR. as above); 45, 2090 (vrātyānāṃ Dºānāṃ, PCR. as above).--§ 608 (do.): VIII, 73, 3650 (Govāsa-Dºānāṃ). Cf. next.
Dāsanīya, a people(?). § 295 (Dyūtap.): II, 51, 1825 (Govāsanā brāhmaṇāś ca Dāsanīyāś ca, Nīl. = dāsyayogyāḥ śūdrādayaḥ. BR. compares the preceding).

Dasra, one of the Aśvins. § 15 (Upamanyu): I, 3, ††723 (Nāsatya-Dºau).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 89, †4594 (among the surgeons of Indra, not in B.).--§ 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7583 (Nāsatyaś caiva Dasraś ca smṛtau dvāv Aśvināv api).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 340, 12917 (Nāsatyañ caiva Dºñ ca bhishajau).--§ 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7095 (Nāsatyaś cāpi Dºaś ca smṛtau dvāv Aśvināv api).
Dasyumat, a fire. § 493 (Āṅgirasa): III, 221, 14203 (only C.; B. has Vasumat).
